headDetails.description: A VRChat sub-community focused on serenity, low-energy social interaction, and structured chaos.

hero.title: Chill
hero.subtitle: Cultivating peace and structure within VRChat's chaos.
hero.description: A community-led sanctuary in VRChat focused on digital well-being, serenity, and low-energy social interaction.

lore.label: 01 — Origin & Symbology
lore.title: The Art of Structured Chaos
lore.subtitle: Our roots in the FISH ＜＞＜ community and the meaning of the symbol.
lore.ecosystemOrigin: Chill ＜＞＜ originated as an officially registered sub-community within the FISH ＜＞＜ network (founded by TheZiver), the First Structure Chaos Community ecosystem in VRChat. The ＜＞＜ symbol represents the fundamental balance between order and disorder in virtual worlds.

chaosLeft.title: Initial Chaos
chaosLeft.subtitle: Noise & Entropy
chaosLeft.text: VRChat's natural tendency toward disorder: heavy avatars, loud audio, and overwhelming social environments when boundaries are lacking.

structure.title: Structure (Chill)
structure.subtitle: Our Identity
structure.text: The intentional application of moderation, controlled volume, and clear guidelines. Chill specifically embodies this symbol (＞) to provide calm.

chaosRight.title: Return of Chaos
chaosRight.subtitle: Human Flow
chaosRight.text: Despite structure, spontaneity and chaos re-emerge naturally. The goal is not suppression, but healthy management.

structuredChaos.title: Structured Chaos
structuredChaos.subtitle: The Perfect Balance
structuredChaos.text: The resulting state where social freedom and fun co-exist under healthy boundaries to prevent sensory burnout.

roleCard.title: Our Specific Role: The Structure Force ＞
roleCard.text: Within the FISH network, Chill does not attempt to span all spectrums of chaos. We act as the architects of Structure (＞): building the quiet sanctuary where VRChat users can rest while staying connected.

cards.title: The VRChat Landscape
cards.content: VRChat provides boundless creative freedom, but frequently leads to 'digital noise'—visual clutter, loud microphones, and exhausting events causing social fatigue.

cards.title: The Chill Response
cards.content: We established ourselves as a necessary counterbalance: a 'third place' in VRChat designed to rest, chat quietly, and decompress with clear guidelines.

values.label: 02 — Principles & Conduct
values.title: Our Core Pillars
values.description: We maintain Structure (＞) in VRChat through three core pillars.

pillars.title: Audio Discipline
pillars.text: Conversations are kept at a moderate volume. No mic-spamming or loud music in our instances.

pillars.title: Visual Clarity
pillars.text: We discourage visual clutter, filtering out blinding lights and massive particle systems.

pillars.title: Sanctuary Culture
pillars.text: Zero-tolerance policy for toxicity, ensuring a safe space where everyone feels respected.

protocols.label: Instance Rules
protocols.title: VRChat Guidelines & Conduct
protocols.description: Clear guidelines enforced during our instance openings.

list.title: Audio Discipline
list.desc: Keep a conversational voice tone. No music through microphones.

list.title: Visual Clarity
list.desc: No blinding lights or massive particle effects on avatars.

list.title: Respect the Calm
list.desc: No toxicity, harassment, or intentional drama.

list.title: No Chaos Roleplay
list.desc: Do not bring chaotic dynamics into our chill relaxation instances.

list.title: T.O.S. Compliance
list.desc: Strict adherence to official VRChat Terms of Service.

groups.name: FISH ＜＞＜

groups.name: FISH CERTIFIED

groups.name: FISH REGISTERED

groups.name: Chill ＜＞＜

vision.label: Looking Forward
vision.title: Our Vision
vision.quote: In a noisy and hyper-connected VRChat, shared serenity is an invaluable harbor.
vision.text: Chill proves that by applying the right amount of structure (＞), we can cultivate true sanctuaries of peace and lasting friendships.
